changes: Retain existing A* and exact collider-footprint checks; precompute frontier coordinates and f-scores instead of decoding keys and recalculating hypot in every comparison.
Lazy directed-grid edge memoization with two bytes per cell; new Navigation instance invalidates it when scene geometry rebuilds.
Reuse unreachable results and evict one oldest route at the200-entry limit instead of clearing the entire route cache.
